body:
[SCI-TEMPORAL C · necessary range-only caller hunk, before edit]
The real applyOperations port deliberately does not invoke the generic referee; all whole/nested/range-leaf probes actually commit the invented range. edit_graph whole/nested probes also write it. Field-safety alone cannot close both writers.
Extending the accepted lease only to existing apply-operations.ts and orchestrator/tools/edit-graph.ts post-encoding boundary: compare range identity against the server-read before graph and refuse new/changed ranges; the dedicated native approved writer remains the only range writer. No request approval flag, generic authority or B3 coupled writer added.
Quantity metadata guard reuses existing raw-scale resolution and unitComparisonKey; native builder referees ordinary level fields and binds approved range to its exact target postimage. Schemas/persist range validation unchanged. New served3ede/.75 consumed; one baseline refresh/dependency rebind before final controls, not repeated during repair.
